primary_task: Register or update prompt-based agents in an Azure AI Foundry project by POSTing a local JSON manifest to the Foundry Agent Service REST API.

requirements.name: Azure AI Foundry project endpoint / ai.azure.com
requirements.basis: other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, Microsoft Learn and Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA)

requirements.name: Azure CLI login with Azure AI User role on the Foundry project
requirements.evidence: 2. Azure CLI (`az`) authenticated with access to the Foundry project; 3. The **Azure AI User** role (or higher) on the Foundry project resource
requirements.basis: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, ...)

requirements.name: az (Azure CLI)
requirements.evidence: az account set --subscription $SubscriptionId; az account get-access-token
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, ...) - az is obtainable via pip/apt, but is useless without Azure access

requirements.name: PowerShell (pwsh)
requirements.evidence: Step 4: Execute the PowerShell script with the collected parameters (a bash variant is also described)
requirements.basis: Manifest lacks 'PowerShell on Windows' only and says nothing of pwsh on Linux; would need to check whether pwsh can be installed from apt/GitHub releases

requirements.name: Foundry project with a deployed model
requirements.evidence: 1. An Azure AI Foundry project with a deployed model (e.g. `gpt-5-4`)
requirements.basis: There are no accounts or credentials for other external services.

blocking: egress:Azure AI Foundry project endpoint / ai.azure.com
credential:Azure CLI login with Azure AI User role on the Foundry project
other:Foundry project with a deployed model
notes: Only scaffolding the manifest and script (local files) would be achievable; I took the stated purpose (registering agents in the Foundry service) as the primary task. If the primary task were only scaffolding the manifest and script, the verdict would be ACHIEVABLE.
